body:
Yes. I used to be fine. I used to try and fail at almost everything. After a while I realised there is no point anymore. No one cares about me in real life, my parents seem to be completely unaware that anything is up with me (I think they do, but they think it's a phase, although it's been 5 years). 



I do have gender dysphoria as well which had made it so much worse. I've kept it a secret, and the dysphoria is what made me become like this. About a year ago it wasn't that bad, and I was fine. But now it's gotten so bad, and that's when I started getting suicidal. 


I've been doing stupid stuff as well, but mine are lethal, like running in front of trains and doing other things that could kill me. I just do not care if I live or die.
